reason: A DeepSeek Harness GUI marketplace for browsing, searching, scanning, installing, updating, enabling, disabling, and uninstalling community plugins through GitHub and the official plugin mechanism.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图形化插件市场，用于浏览、搜索、检查并安装、更新、启用、停用或卸载社区插件。
summaries.en: A graphical plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness that lets users browse, search, inspect, install, update, enable, disable, and uninstall community plugins.

capabilities: Searches GitHub plugin metadata and repositories
Runs package-manager and shell commands for plugin installation, update, and removal
Reads and writes DeepSeek Harness profile and plugin configuration files
Installs third-party plugins and their dependencies
Reads local Git credentials for repository starring and GitHub token features
Uses direct, proxy, and mirror network routes to fetch metadata and packages
